item.title: MCP Doesn't Make Your Model Smarter, It Makes It Capable
item.description: This is my first post in my “Today I Learned” series. Words like MCP host, MCP server, protocol, agent, subagent, tool, and RAG get thrown around so easily as buzzwords. I tried to put together a simple explanation of them so that anyone can understand it.
